card.name: Sildenafil name and Lao script
card.fires_on: The drug name sildenafil when it follows words like by, of or to in warnings and contraindications. Also fires on broken pieces of Lao script characters.

modes.label: Sildenafil in warnings
modes.description: The word sildenafil as the object of by, of or to in interaction and hypersensitivity statements.
modes.example: WARNINGS Amplification of the vasodilatory effects of nitroglycerin by<< sildenafil>> can result in severe hypotension.

modes.label: Lao script pieces
modes.description: Partial or broken characters inside Lao-language text, such as a national motto.

card.plain: It lights up on the drug name sildenafil in warning text and on scrambled Lao letters.
